The case-memory model scored 0.740, showing a strong resemblance to confirmed-fraud closed cases where 8 of the 8 most similar cases were confirmed fraud, and the card had a prior confirmed-fraud case within the preceding 45 days. The verdict is fraud with an undocumented pattern and an exposure of $1,499.85. The following final actions are to be taken: BLOCK_CARD (L1), CREATE_CASE (auto), FILE_REPORT (L2), and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST (auto).

sar.narrative: Customer C12897, holder of card C12897-K1, is the subject of this report following a monitoring alert for structuring. Between 2016-11-28 01:34 and 2016-11-28 01:44, three online transactions totaling $1,499.85 were executed on the card from the device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.0.3 | mobile safari generic | 2208x1242', including transaction 3493524 for $499.93 at 01:34, transaction 3493535 for $499.96 at 01:42, and transaction 3493541 for $499.96 at 01:44. Each amount sat just below a $500 authorization threshold and the purchases were placed minutes apart to evade detection. The activity is suspicious because a case-memory model score of 0.740 and a feature profile including Vesta V/C/D/M/id features strongly resemble confirmed-fraud closed cases such as CC-3907, CC-3841, CC-4086, and CC-3748. Furthermore, card C12897-K1 experienced one confirmed-fraud case (CC-5094) in the 45 days prior to the alert, indicating the card may still be compromised. In response to this activity, the bank has executed a case creation and escalated the matter to an analyst, while recommending the level 1 approval actions of blocking the card, level 2 approval of filing this report, and placing linked cards under monitoring.
